task: Correct the Osaka City finale balance (osk-4) in the current working tree (uncommitted O1 implementation). Controller review found: (1) the finale is easier than osk-3 — priority three-hero first-try at AP5 is 93.9% vs osk-3's 74.4%, and Mage/Ninja win osk-4 ~100% at every AP; (2) the phase-2 lesson is missing — the naive bot has 0 Core-broken defeats in osk-4 (131 hero deaths), so guarding the Core against Star Fall never matters; (3) Fighter's osk-4 first-try falls as AP rises (naive 63/47/7/72% at AP5-8, priority 87/72/72/100%), which looks like a bot or encounter artifact.
requirements: Inspect the existing diff first. Preserve everything that is correct (data, wiring, story, ending, records, tests, browser checks, docs, osk-1..3 numbers); change only osk-4 tuning, its enemy numbers, and the balance assertions/report for it. Do not start over.

Diagnose (3) before tuning: trace a few Fighter osk-4 runs at AP5 vs AP7 (same seeds) and explain why more AP loses more often (e.g. AP spending order skips Guard before a telegraphed heavy, the extra AP triggers a different wave timing, a Power Slash/BREAK interaction). If it is a bot policy flaw, fix the bot for both policies consistently (do not change earlier cities' report lines); if it is real game behaviour, report it and tune around it. Put the explanation in the summary.

Then tune osk-4 (only numbers marked tune: Black Star forms' HP/attack/heavy/heavyEvery/callEvery, Core hp, wave line-ups within the section 2 rosters, call budgets) so the finale is the climax: priority three-hero first-try mean at AP5 <= 60% and lower than osk-3's AP5 mean; still >= 10% / 60% / 90% at AP5 / 7 / 10; every hero's priority rate at AP7 >= 40%; three-hero means non-decreasing from AP5 to AP7 to AP10 for both bots (small noise <= 5 points allowed); Core-broken defeats >= 25% of naive osk-4 first-try defeats (phase 2 must threaten the Core); priority beats naive by >= 10 points on average at AP5-7; osk-4 mean length <= 45 player turns at AP7; city mean retries at AP5 <= 5 for the priority bot; both bots still complete the city at every AP 0-10.
Encode these as assertions in test/balance.test.js next to the existing Osaka ones (replace any now-wrong ones); show each new assertion fails once with an impossible threshold, then restore.
Matsubara, Sakai, Yao and Higashiosaka report lines byte-identical (diff against the saved pre-change output).

Delete the intermediate .ai/osaka-balance-tuning*.txt, .ai/osaka-balance-initial.txt and .ai/osaka-tests-final.txt scratch files; keep only .ai/osaka-balance-before.txt and an updated .ai/osaka-balance-after.txt (and the assertion proof).
Update the DESIGN_DECISIONS.md Osaka balance entry (the Fighter cause, final numbers and why) and the CURRENT_STATE.md balance lines; revise, do not append logs.
constraints: Do not change osk-1..osk-3, earlier cities, sprite code, maps, osaka-map.js, the H1 Core contract or the story/ending/records wiring.
Do not touch test/browser/playthrough.mjs; the controller runs the browser acceptance after this correction.
Edit source with structured edit tools; on the first shell quoting/escaping failure switch to file edit tools.
Do not commit. Do not delete other .ai files.
